rule: Frozen copy of SCHEMA_HISTORY in src/db/db.ts. NEVER change an existing version here or in db.ts: people's catalogs live in those layouts. To change the database, add version N+1 (with an upgrade function) to db.ts, add it to SCHEMA_HISTORY, then append it here. test/unit/db.test.ts checks both files agree and that every old version upgrades without losing rows.
